blocks.tamil_translation: and a needle for weaving cloth behind in her house. One of her goats and the needle went missing. That woman said, “O my Lord! You have taken on the responsibility of protecting the person who sets out in Your path and his belongings!. (I had gone out in Your path, and while I was away) one of my goats and a needle for weaving cloth went missing. I ask You, swearing by You, for my goat and my needle (that my belongings be returned to me).” The narrator of this hadith says, “The Prophet ﷺ explained to that man of the Tufawah tribe how that woman had made Du'a to her Lord with great humility.” “Her goat and another goat like it, and her needle and another needle like it, were given to that woman from the treasury (khazanah) of Allah Ta'ala.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “This is that woman; if you wish, go to her and ask her.” “No,” I said to Rasulullah ﷺ, “there is no need to ask that woman; I accept as true what I have heard from you (I have complete trust in you),”” said that man of the Tufawah tribe.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْجِهَادِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ ، فَإِنَّهُ بَابٌ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ، يُذْهِبُ اللهُ بِهِ الْهَمَّ وَالْغَمَّ (وَزَادَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ۞) وَجَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ الْقَرِيبَ وَالْبَعِيدَ، وَأَقِيمُوا حُدُودَ اللهِ فِي الْقَرِيبِ وَالْبَعِيدِ، وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُمْ فِي اللهِ لَوْمَةُ لَائِمٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه، ووافقه الذهبي:٢ /٧٤
